root_cause.text: The `check_imm` macro in the arm64 BPF JIT compiler contains an off-by-one error in its signed range validation logic, shifting the immediate value by `bits` instead of `bits - 1`, which permits values exceeding the valid signed N-bit field range to bypass the check.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states that the original check `(imm > 0 && imm >> bits)` admits values in `[-2^N, 2^N)`—effectively a signed (N+1)-bit range—whereas a signed N-bit field only holds `[-2^(N-1), 2^(N-1))`, and the patch diff confirms the fix changes the shift operand from `(bits)` to `((bits) - 1)` in both positive and negative conditions within the macro.
